mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indexes
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1400, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 4.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tightening labor market, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to expected inflationary pressures.
evidence_refs: fact:historical relationship between UNRATE and inflation
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 signals increased economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when INDPRO > 105, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of increasing housing starts (HOUST) and rising retail sales (RSAFS) signals broadening consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST, RSAFS, and consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase above 5.0% signals monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.5%) and increasing payroll employment (PAYEMS > 150000) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical relationship between labor market and economic growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 3.0% signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window during mid-cycle expansions, or 20-day forward returns when GDPC1 > 3.0% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in those regimes.
